new_entities.name: Clopidogrel used with a proton pump inhibitor
aliases: concomitant clopidogrel and omeprazole or pantoprazole
new_entities.description: Concurrent use of clopidogrel with proton pump inhibitor treatment.

new_entities.name: Excess cardiovascular events
new_entities.description: Apparent excess in major cardiovascular events such as myocardial infarction, cardiovascular death, stent thrombosis, or related ischemic composites.

edges.effect_quant: Observational-heavy meta-analyses reported higher cardiovascular event rates with concomitant PPI use, including OR 1.41 across 13 studies and 48,674 patients and OR 1.37 after PCI, but randomized-trial meta-analysis found no significant excess signal with concomitant PPI use (RR 0.99).
edges.population: adults receiving clopidogrel after acute coronary syndrome or percutaneous coronary intervention who also use proton pump inhibitors
edges.mechanism: Some PPIs, especially stronger CYP2C19 inhibitors, may blunt clopidogrel bioactivation and reduce platelet inhibition, but confounding by indication and higher baseline cardiovascular risk can exaggerate apparent harm in observational datasets.
edges.summary: This is an honestly contested interaction edge. Platelet-function studies support a biologically plausible interaction, yet better-controlled clinical evidence does not consistently show a clear increase in hard cardiovascular outcomes, so the real-world penalty remains unsettled rather than resolved.
edges.caveats: Results vary by study design, specific PPI, and patient selection. This edge addresses cardiovascular outcomes only and does not negate the separate gastrointestinal-protection benefit of PPIs in patients with meaningful bleeding risk.

evidence.citation: Hulot JS et al 2010 J Am Coll Cardiol
evidence.notes: Cardiovascular risk in clopidogrel-treated patients according to cytochrome P450 2C19*2 loss-of-function allele or proton pump inhibitor coadministration: a systematic meta-analysis.

effect_quant.comparator: major adverse cardiovascular events with PPI plus clopidogrel versus clopidogrel without PPI

evidence.citation: Kwok CS et al 2013 Int J Cardiol
evidence.notes: No consistent evidence of differential cardiovascular risk amongst proton-pump inhibitors when used with clopidogrel: meta-analysis.

effect_quant.comparator: all-cause mortality with PPI plus clopidogrel versus clopidogrel without PPI in pooled analysis
